name: Soul of the Monk
body:
Associated Skills: Acrobatics, Knowledge (religion), Perception, Sense Motive

Associated Veils: Astral Pugilism, Belt of Woven Gold, Brume Treads, Darkholds, Five Rivers Amulet, Forcestrike Knuckles, Sentinel’s Helm, Stalker’s Tabi

Flurry of Blows (Ex)

At 1st level, tapping into the soul of the monk infuses you with knowledge of formidable martial arts, granting you Improved Unarmed Strike feat as a bonus feat, increasing your unarmed damage die to 1d6 (1d4 Small, 1d8 Large) and allowing you to make a flurry of blows as a full-attack action. When making a flurry of blows, you can make one additional attack at your highest base attack bonus but all of your attacks suffer a -2 penalty. This additional attack stacks with the bonus attacks from haste and other similar effects (except for the flurry of blows class feature from another source). When using this ability, you can make these attacks with any combination of your unarmed strikes and weapons that have the monk special weapon quality. You take no penalty for using multiple weapons when making a flurry of blows, but you do not gain any additional attacks beyond what’s already granted by the flurry for doing so.

At 11th level, you can make an additional attack at your highest base attack bonus whenever you make a flurry of blows. This stacks with the first attack from this ability and additional attacks from haste and similar effects.

Ki Pool (Su)

At 3rd level, tapping into the monk’s soul grants you a pool of ki points which you can use to enhance your unarmed strikes. This pool has a number of ki points equal to 1/2 your soulforge level + your Wisdom modifier.

By spending 1 point from your ki pool as a swift action, you can make one additional unarmed strike at your highest attack bonus when making a flurry of blows attack. This bonus attack stacks with all bonus attacks gained from flurry of blows, as well as those from haste and similar effects.

As long as you have 1 point of ki in your ki pool, your unarmed strikes count as magic for the purposes of bypassing damage reduction.

At 7th level, your unarmed attacks are also treated as cold iron and silver for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction as long as you have 1 point of ki in your ki pool.

At 11th level, your unarmed attacks are also treated as lawful weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction as long as you have 1 point of ki in your ki pool.

At 17th level, your unarmed attacks are treated as adamantine weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction and bypassing hardness as long as you have 1 point of ki in your ki pool.
